state: ACTIVE; original bound remains 20/3 <= gn(R-minus) <= 1847/276. No strict-gain law or unrestricted improved upper bound has been delivered.

substantive_findings.finding: Every law on one fixed coset of the explicit triangle parity code obeys H(X_V)<=2/3 sum_v H(X_v), including nonuniform and cross-triangle-correlated laws.
All binary syndrome planes have linear 4-clique transversals, so support in any three parity-code cosets cannot exceed 2^20 words; restricted binary cardinality scope only.
A four-word actual FD law has fair two-valued syndrome independent of every vertex, refuting the separate mixed-syndrome mutual-information shortcut.

All rank-13 subcodes of the fixed triangle code with per-vertex images dimension at most two are covered by 61 exact-checked representations, which rule out a particular 16-equal-coset, <=2-of-16 bias strict-gain criterion.

scope_and_blocker: The construction obstructions do not rule out unequal weights, other numbers of cosets, smaller-rank or different-code representations, arbitrary alphabets, or a genuinely new full-copy inequality. One 32-class exact-gain search returned solver UNKNOWN, not infeasibility. The full publisher copy LP has no exact primal or strengthened dual certificate here.
